description: [general] Praxis Architecture Pillar Isolation Isol — Full DEEP journey covering CRUD, validation, and persistence + cross-service integration

steps.description: Load saved superadmin session or log in
steps.action: Load saved session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/praxis-trunk-main-state.json'. If the session is expired or missing, navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login, enter email 'qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com' and password QA_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD, then submit the login form.
steps.expected: The Praxis layout renders with the sidebar visible and pillar groups present: Today, Health, Wealth, Happiness, Wisdom, Tools, Settings. An amber Admin group is also visible in the sidebar, confirming superadmin tier. No redirect to login occurs.

steps.description: Confirm superadmin identity via admin panel access
steps.action: Click the Admin group (amber) in the sidebar to expand it, then click into any admin sub-tab (e.g. Users or Audit Log).
steps.expected: The Admin section expands and renders without a 403 or redirect. The URL updates to an admin route (e.g. /praxis?ptab=admin-users or equivalent). This confirms the session holds superadmin privileges required for PUT /api/v1/admin/praxis-config.

steps.description: Navigate to Praxis config admin route and inspect current config
steps.action: In the browser, navigate directly to the admin config endpoint by opening the browser dev-tools Network tab, then from the admin UI trigger a GET to /api/v1/admin/praxis-config (or navigate to the admin Settings/Config sub-tab if surfaced in the UI).
steps.expected: A 200 response is returned from GET /api/v1/admin/praxis-config. The response body is a valid JSON object containing at least one Praxis configuration key (e.g. kill-switch states, feature flags, or tier settings). No 401, 403, or 404 is returned.

steps.description: Exercise PUT /api/v1/admin/praxis-config with a valid payload
steps.action: Using the browser dev-tools console (or the admin UI config form if present), issue a PUT request to /api/v1/admin/praxis-config with a valid JSON body representing an updated configuration value (e.g. toggling a non-critical feature flag or updating a threshold value that is present in the current config). Set Content-Type: application/json and include the session cookie.
steps.expected: The server returns HTTP 200. The response body confirms the updated configuration value is reflected back. No 422 Unprocessable Entity, 401 Unauthorized, or 500 error is returned.

steps.description: Validate that the PUT change is rejected for a non-superadmin user (auth isolation check)
steps.action: Open a new incognito/private browser window. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login and log in with a known personal-tier test account (not the superadmin). Once logged in, attempt to issue a PUT request to /api/v1/admin/praxis-config via the dev-tools console with the same payload used in Step 4.
steps.expected: The server returns HTTP 403 Forbidden (or 401 Unauthorized). The personal-tier user cannot modify Praxis config. No data is mutated. This confirms the admin route is properly gated.

steps.description: Verify pillar group isolation: Today pillar renders independently
steps.action: Return to the superadmin browser session. Click the 'Today' pillar group in the sidebar. Confirm Dashboard, Calendar, Meetings, Tasks, and Plan tabs are listed under it. Click the 'Dashboard' tab.
steps.expected: The Today pillar group expands and its accent colour is applied. The Dashboard tab content renders. The URL updates to reflect the active tab (e.g. /praxis or /praxis?ptab=dashboard). No content from other pillar groups (Health, Wealth, etc.) bleeds into this view.

steps.description: Verify pillar group isolation: Wealth pillar (Finance tab) renders independently
steps.action: Click the 'Wealth' pillar group in the sidebar. Wait for it to expand. Click the 'Finance' tab.
steps.expected: The Wealth sidebar group expands and highlights with its pillar accent colour. The active tab indicator moves to Finance. The URL updates to /praxis/finance or /praxis?ptab=finance (or equivalent). Finance content renders without navigation errors. Due to the known data backload limitation (tables are empty as of 2026-04-26), an empty-state UI (e.g. 'No data yet' or similar placeholder) is acceptable — a hard error or 500 is not acceptable.

steps.description: Verify pillar group isolation: switching pillars clears prior pillar state
steps.action: With the Finance tab active (Wealth pillar), click the 'Health' pillar group. Click the 'Habits' tab.
steps.expected: The Wealth pillar group collapses (or loses active styling). The Health pillar group expands and highlights with its own accent. The Habits tab content renders. No Finance data or UI fragments remain visible. The URL updates to /praxis/habits or equivalent. This confirms pillar isolation — each pillar renders its own scoped state.

steps.description: Navigate away from Praxis and return — verify persistence of config change
steps.action: Navigate away from the Praxis portal entirely by going to a non-Praxis page (e.g. http://localhost:3002 or the portal dashboard). Wait 2 seconds. Then navigate back to the Praxis admin config area (e.g. re-open /api/v1/admin/praxis-config via GET in dev-tools or re-open the admin config sub-tab).
steps.expected: The configuration value updated in Step 4 is still reflected in the response from GET /api/v1/admin/praxis-config. The change was persisted to the database, not just held in memory. The updated value matches what was submitted in the PUT request.

steps.description: Verify Admin group visibility is superadmin-only (pillar isolation — auth tier)
steps.action: Log out of the superadmin session. Log in as a personal-tier user. Inspect the Praxis sidebar.
steps.expected: The amber Admin group is NOT visible in the sidebar for the personal-tier user. The sidebar shows only the standard pillar groups (Today, Health, Wealth, Happiness, Wisdom, Tools, Settings). This confirms that admin pillar isolation is enforced at the UI layer in addition to the API layer verified in Step 5.

description: [DEEP] praxis-share-pillar — token lifecycle (create/list/revoke); view is Phase 43 WIP

steps.description: Load saved superadmin session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/praxis-trunk-superadmin-state.json' using the browser storage state tool. Verify the session is active by checking no login prompt appears.
POST /api/v1/share/pillar/token with scope='pillar:wealth'. Verify: (a) HTTP 201 (not 200), (b) response contains token_id. NOTE: the endpoint was previously returning 200 — this tests the fix.
GET /api/v1/share/pillar/token to list active tokens. Verify the newly created token appears in the list. Token lifecycle is implemented correctly.

DELETE /api/v1/share/pillar/token/{token_id} to revoke the token. Verify HTTP 204. Then GET /api/v1/share/pillar/token/{token_id}/view and verify HTTP 410 Gone (not 404) — this confirms the revoked vs missing distinction works.

NOTE: The public share view page (/praxis/share/pillar/{token}) is Phase 43 WIP — it currently returns a placeholder message and is blocked by auth middleware. Do NOT assert that it shows pillar scores. Just verify the token lifecycle above passed. Navigate back to dashboard.
